title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Embed Ranks #1 Overall on RTEB, Advancing Agentic Retrieval
brief: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Embed model achieved the #1 ranking on the RTEB (Retrieval Text Embedding Benchmark) leaderboard, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI workflows. This advancement reflects NVIDIA's progress in embedding models critical for improving retrieval accuracy in enterprise AI systems.
